A more useful Nutrients page on the Diary. Install it over 1.0.8; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.9/Spectra.apk)**

### Nutrients page
- **Score and count:** for example "93% of targets · 74 of 85 met".
- **Short today** lists only real gaps. Fluoride (it comes from water, not food) and omega-6 (judged by its ratio) are no longer scored. Nutrients most of the day's foods don't list, such as chromium and iodine, are left out and named in a note at the bottom, so a missing label value doesn't look like a shortfall.
- **A fix for each gap** from foods you already eat, at your usual portion: "60 g Baby Spinach would cover it", or "Try salmon, sardines, mackerel" when none of your foods helps much. Foods heavy in sodium, added sugar or saturated fat aren't suggested.
- **Watch today:** sodium, saturated fat and added sugar against their limits, plus your omega-6 : omega-3 ratio, colored as they get close or go over. Tap one for the day's foods behind it; from there you can open your average over time.
